page.content:
Crusader state that occupied Constantinople from 1204 to 1261.

How Latin Empire connects

  • Event: Fourth Crusade — The crusade created the Latin Empire.
  • Location: Constantinople — The Latin Empire occupied Constantinople.
  • Event: Recapture of Constantinople (1261) — The 1261 recapture ended the Latin Empire in the city.

What is Latin Empire?

The Latin Empire was the Frankish regime installed after the Fourth Crusade, ruling Constantinople until the Palaiologoi returned in 1261.

Key threads lead to Fourth Crusade, Constantinople and Recapture of Constantinople (1261).
